prompt: The audio clip plays once but then throws IllegalStateException when called again. Why?
choices: Clip can only play once per JVM session
The AudioInputStream was already consumed — you must call clip.setFramePosition(0) before replaying
start() must be called from the main thread only
explanation: After a clip finishes playing, its frame position is at the end. Call clip.setFramePosition(0); before clip.start(); to rewind. Or use clip.loop(0) which resets position automatically. IllegalStateException can also occur if the clip is in the wrong state — check clip.isOpen().
